candidate_reports.remark: In West Springfield_ a basement was flooding on Westfield St. Relayed by amateur radio.
In Palmer_ Wilbraham St underpass was flooded and impassable. Relayed by amateur radio.
In West Springfield_ a basement was flooding on Elm St. Relayed by amateur radio.
In West Springfield_ Rt 5 was closed from the north end bridge to memorial bridge due to both underpasses flooded to 2+ feet depth. Relayed by amateur radio.
In Enfield_ Cranbrook Blvd at Freshwater Blvd was closed due to flooding. Relayed by amateur radio.
In Agawam_ White Brook (also known as Deep Guttar Brook) was out of its banks and flooding North St with a car stuck in the flooding. Relayed by amateur radio.
In Agawam_ the Rt 5 underpass was flooded and impassable with a car stuck in the flooding. Relayed by amateur radio.
